commits_data.title: Convert "easy" wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool
commits_data.message:
Convert "easy" wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool

Take all of the calls to wmem_packet_scope() that already had access to (non-NULL) pinfo and convert them to use pinfo->pool since wmem_packet_scope() has been deprecated.
